channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Green GSM Enters Northern Mindanao
item.description: Green GSM has officially launched its all-electric taxi service in Northern Mindanao following a trial operation that began in late August. The company introduced the service on September 29 in El Salvador, Misamis Oriental, with its VinFast electric taxi fleet now available in Cagayan de Oro, Lagui

item.title: Family mileage
item.description: Filipino families who want to switch to a hybrid SUV without worrying about charging stations have another option in the GAC GS4 Max HEV, which combines gasoline and electric power with the convenience of conventional refueling.

item.title: VinFast opens 36th Phl dealership
item.description: VinFast has opened its 36th dealership in the Philippines in Pasay City as the Vietnamese electric vehicle manufacturer continues to expand its local sales and service network.

item.title: Hyundai unveils all-new Tucson
item.description: Hyundai Motor has unveiled the next-generation Tucson in Europe with a larger body, a redesigned cabin and a choice of petrol or electrified powertrains.

item.title: CAMPI eyes sales recovery
item.description: Philippine vehicle sales fell sharply in August after severe weather disrupted dealership operations and consumer activity, although industry officials expect demand to recover before year-end.

item.title: Honda caps final RS125 run
item.description: Honda Philippines Inc. (HPI) will limit production of its RS125 Final Edition to 20,000 units, with the motorcycle set to remain available until March 2028 as the company prepares to retire the model after nearly two decades.

item.title: Who protects the pedestrians?
item.description: On 24 June, 90-year-old Erlinda Santos Tagle was on her way to serve at St. Augustine Church in San Fernando, Pampanga, when a vehicle struck her while she was crossing the pedestrian lane outside the church.

item.title: Geely Breaks 1,000 Mark
item.description: Geely Motor Philippines recorded its highest monthly sales in September 2026, with 1,023 vehicles sold as demand for its electric and hybrid models accounted for nearly 80 percent of the total. item.title: Toyota’s Akio Toyoda joins Automotive Hall of Fame
item.description: Toyota Motor Corporation chairman Akio Toyoda was inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame on 23 September in Detroit, Michigan, in recognition of his contributions to the Japanese automaker and the global automotive industry.

item.title: Tesla Adds Emergency Feature So You Can Drive Away From Supercharger Without Unplugging
item.description: A fatal incident at a Tesla Supercharger prompted the automaker to make this change. The post Tesla Adds Emergency Feature So You Can Drive Away From Supercharger Without Unplugging appeared first on The Drive .

item.title: Costco Sells Diesel, But Only At Select Locations
item.description: Many Costco fuel stations do not offer diesel, but that doesn't mean that none of them do. Here's where you can find Costco diesel stations around the country.

item.title: Ferrari Achieved Automotive Perfection With The 1969 Dino 246 GT
item.description: Ferrari couldn't bring itself to put its name on the Dino, but there's something about it that speaks to our Brad Brownell like no other car ever built.
